title: Migration failure names the failing version and leaves the store unchanged past it
asA: operator diagnosing a deploy that failed at boot on a migration
iWant: the failure to name the failing version and its description in a stable-coded error, and to leave the store on the previous version so recovery is a code fix and a redeploy
soThat: the diagnostic loop is one step (open the failing migration, fix, redeploy) instead of a data-recovery incident

acceptanceCriteria.description: When a migration's statements or its bookkeeping row fails, the migration runner throws an error whose code is a stable identifier for the migration-failed condition, whose message contains the failing version integer and the migration's description string.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a store at version v_k and a pending migration v_k+1 whose statements throw
acceptanceCriteria.then: the thrown error's code is a stable string identifier documented in the store facade, and its message contains the integer v_k+1 and the description string configured on that migration

acceptanceCriteria.description: The store facade's open entry point propagates the migration failure to its caller without swallowing it or converting it to a different error class.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a boot sequence whose migration run fails on v_k+1
acceptanceCriteria.when: the caller catches the error thrown by the open entry point
acceptanceCriteria.then: the caught error is the same error the migration runner threw, with the same code and message, unwrapped or wrapped in a chain that preserves the original code and message

acceptanceCriteria.description: A store whose migration failed at v_k+1 opens cleanly on a subsequent boot after v_k+1 is fixed and the build is redeployed; no manual recovery step is required against the on-disk artifact.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the failing v_k+1 statement is corrected in the migration catalog and the same store artifact is opened by the corrected build
acceptanceCriteria.when: the boot sequence invokes the open entry point
acceptanceCriteria.then: the migration runner applies v_k+1 and any later pending migrations, the migrated event fires, and consumer code sees the store at the build's max known version
